title: Cowboys rookie Shiyazh Pete touched by outpouring of support from Navajo fans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys rookie Shiyazh Pete touched by outpouring of support from Navajo fans
sources.description: It's not often that an undrafted rookie offensive lineman has a larger contingent of fans at an NFL game than any of his teammates, but that happened for Cowboys tackle Shiyazh Pete against the Cardinals on Saturday in Arizona.
